rca_of_issue: Original bug: Expo Go on Android crashed with AppearanceModule.setColorScheme received a null value. RCA: react-native's Appearance.setColorScheme rejects null on Android's native AppearanceModule; the previous code path could pass null (from unresolved 'system' preference or from the removed module-import-time call). Fix applied in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts:114-124: setColorScheme now (a) coerces null/undefined/'system' → Appearance.getColorScheme() ?? 'light', (b) only ever passes a concrete 'light'|'dark' string to the native module, and (c) wraps the native call in try/catch. Additionally, the module-import-time invocation was removed; theme initialization now happens inside app/_layout.tsx useEffect (post-mount, async, from persisted preference). Web preview verification: 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 setColorScheme/Appearance-related warnings across onboarding, login, home, settings toggle ON/OFF/persist, and all core routes.
